name: Blueberry Fields of Stillwater LLC
description: Blueberry Fields of Stillwater LLC is an agritourism farm in 450 Mendel Road North, MN, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
